name: Seis pelo Japão
description: A private trip-planning app for six travellers heading to Japan this winter. Washi paper, five inks and station-style stamps that get inked as things happen. Hidden preference votes, a ranked ballot over four routes, a route builder that enforces twenty nights and New Year closures, shared expenses in yen, an offline notebook, and a Today screen with the hotel address in Japanese for taxi drivers. Portuguese UI, English place names.

name: Rumo à África do Sul
description: A family travel companion in Brazilian Portuguese for sixteen days from Cape Town to a Madikwe safari, built for travellers from their twenties to their seventies on whatever phone they own. An offline-first PWA with a day-by-day diary, an hour-by-hour timeline, a guide and a sommelier you can chat with, live tips near you from Gemini with Google Search, wine labels read by Gemini vision, shared expenses and a notebook that sync when the signal returns, and watercolours generated for every chapter.

name: Portfolio Dashboard
description: A private household planning app for a two-person, three-currency (SGD, USD, BRL) path to financial independence. It opens on one honest sentence, on track, watch or slipping, instead of a wall of charts. A deterministic engine computes the verdict; a grounded assistant explains it and answers "can we afford this?", but never overrides it. No daily tickers, no streaks, no blended yield. Raw statements never leave the machine.

name: FormCoach
description: A personal AI coach for amateur athletes. It reads Whoop recovery and strain, knows the week's schedule, and takes voice notes, text and photos of meals, then turns all of it into the day's training and nutrition guidance. React Native app, a small TypeScript API, and a model that does the coaching.
prompt: An amateur athlete lacing running shoes at dawn on a quiet track, a smartwatch glowing on the wrist, a phone propped nearby showing a simple sound-wave of a voice note, a bowl of fruit and eggs on the bench beside them. Warm, encouraging mood.
